name: aws-badge-streak-agent
description: Autonomous, stealth interaction agent designed to maintain daily streaks on AWS Builder Center

scripts.auth: TAILSCALE_IP=$(tailscale ip -4 2>/dev/null || true) HOST_HOSTNAME=$(hostname 2>/dev/null || true) docker compose run --rm --service-ports auth
scripts.auth:login: TAILSCALE_IP=$(tailscale ip -4 2>/dev/null || true) HOST_HOSTNAME=$(hostname 2>/dev/null || true) docker compose run --rm --service-ports auth
scripts.streak: pnpm build && docker compose run --rm streak-agent run
scripts.streak:force: pnpm build && docker compose run --rm streak-agent run --force --verbose
scripts.streak:watch: pnpm build && TAILSCALE_IP=$(tailscale ip -4 2>/dev/null || true) HOST_HOSTNAME=$(hostname 2>/dev/null || true) docker compose run --rm --service-ports streak-watch
